Select the first 1000 IC50 activity rows with pChEMBL values for human single-protein target CHEMBL1615382 (Nuclear receptor coactivator 3). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1615382, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate rows.
